name: Command Injection via shell=True
diff:
diff --git a/app/tasks.py b/app/tasks.py
index 0000000..1111111 100644
--- a/app/tasks.py
+++ b/app/tasks.py
@@ -1,3 +1,7 @@
 import subprocess
 
 def ping_host(host):
+    cmd = f"ping -c 1 {host}"
+    subprocess.run(cmd, shell=True)
explanation: subprocess.run with shell=True and f-string allows arbitrary shell metacharacter injection.
